name: roll_attack
description: Roll an attack with automatic active-effect modifiers. Loads active effects from both attacker (Bless adds +1d4, Bane subtracts 1d4, advantage/disadvantage from buffs/debuffs) and target (Faerie Fire, Hold Person grant advantage to the attacker). Combines advantage sources correctly (any advantage + any disadvantage = normal). Compares the final total against the target's stored AC and reports HIT, MISS, CRITICAL HIT, or CRITICAL MISS. Use instead of roll_dice for weapon and spell attacks during combat.

attacker_type.description: Whether the attacker is a character or NPC.

attacker.description: Slug or UUID of the attacking entity.

target_type.description: Whether the target is a character or NPC.

target.description: Slug or UUID of the target entity.

attack_modifier.description: Static attack bonus: ability modifier + proficiency bonus + any weapon/magic bonuses. Do NOT include Bless or similar effect dice — those are added automatically from active effects.

mode.description: system: compact single-line result. transparent: full breakdown of d20, modifier, and each effect bonus. user: prompts the player for their d20 roll (noting advantage/disadvantage), then auto-rolls any effect bonus dice.

description.description: Optional label, e.g. 'Shortsword attack' or 'Sacred Flame'.
